title: We're releasing the weights of Mistral Large 4
titleZh: 我们正在发布 Mistral Large 4 的重量
author: kuberwastaken
relevanceReason: 命中 5 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: ThinkingSummaryMistral released Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model, now available with improved coding, cybersecurity, and reasoning efficiency. It leads open-weight benchmarks in coding and defensive security while offering three reasoning modes for cost-performance balance. Fully open-weight and European-trained, it empowers sovereign AI with customizable, self-hosted deployment options.We release the weights of Le Chonk, advancing the frontier of open models in agentic coding and cybersecurity.Earlier this month, we released Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), our flagship 1-trillion-parameter, natively multimodal model, in public preview. The response to the preview has exceeded our expectations, and we're grateful to our developer community, early-access customers, and partners for their support, collaboration, and feedback.Since then, we've put that feedback to work while continuing to scale reinforcement learning, driving massive improvements in coding and defensive cybersecurity. Gains continue to accelerate, with no signs of saturation.Today, we're releasing the weights of this improved Mistral Large 4. The new model also features substantial gains in reasoning efficiency that give developers greater performance while lowering inference costs.Mistral Large 4 ranks as the best open-weight model for coding and among the world's most capable open models overall. Trained from scratch on European infrastructure with clear lineage from inception to release, it gives organizations a trusted foundation for Sovereign AIMistral is defining the sovereign AI category and leading the open frontier. We're committed to building the world's most capable models and releasing them openly, giving developers, enterprises, and institutions the power to own, customize, and control their AI. Built for the Builders.Mistral Large 4 entered public preview with strong results across leading coding benchmarks. Just three weeks of additional reinforcement learning have since propelled it to the forefront of open-weight coding, taking the lead on FrontierCode and Terminal-Bench while matching the best open-weight models on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index with substantially greater token efficiency.On Cognition's private FrontierCode 2.0 benchmark, which assesses end-to-end code quality and whether a repository maintainer would merge the agent's change, Mistral Large 4 leads with a score of 19.7%.Cognition - FrontierCode 2.019.7%2.9%14.2%17.3%17.8%19.3%Mistral Large 4Beam 1.0GLM-5.3 FlashKimi K3GLM-5.3DeepSeek V4.1 FlashScorePushing the pareto frontier for agentic coding.Mistral Large 4 delivers frontier coding performance with significantly fewer tokens, making sophisticated coding agents more economical to run at scale.On the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, Mistral Large 4 scores 48%, effectively tied with the leading open-weight model, GLM-5.3, while using 47% fewer tokens per task on average.Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index vs. Token EfficiencyMistralOther modelsScoreAverage Tokens per Task in millionsMistral Large 4 - MediumMistral Large 4 - HighMuse Spark Open - xhighGLM-5.3DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017Kimi K3Coding Agent Index scores and token efficiencies for reasoning levels available on Artificial AnalysisThe gains extend to terminal-based coding workflows. On Terminal-Bench 4.0, Mistral Large 4 improved by 13 percentage points to 41% compared to its public preview, taking the lead among open-weight models while reducing output tokens by 30%.Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index - Terminal-Bench 4.028%41%3%6%21%31%40%ML4 Preview - selfreportedMistral Large 4Beam 1.0Muse Spark OpenKimi K3DeepSeek V4.1Flash 1017GLM-5.3To give developers greater control over this tradeoff between performance and cost, Mistral Large 4 now supports three reasoning modes:ModeRecommended UseLowSimple tasks; replaces ‘None’ reasoning modeMediumEveryday tasksHigh (default)Hardest use cases requiring high precision and thorough reasoningBeyond benchmarks, Mistral Large 4's coding capabilities are validated by human preference. In Surge Code's blind pairwise evaluations, Mistral Large 4 was preferred over leading open-weight models including GLM-5.3, Kimi K3, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, ranking behind only Claude Opus 5.5 among the models evaluated.Surge Code - Human preference on codeBlind side-by-side win rates against other modelsMistral Large 4 winOther modelGLM-5.3Kimi K3DeepSeek V4.1 FlashClaude Opus 5.550%64%36%64%36%56%44%22%78%Share of prompts where graders preferred Mistral Large 4's answer over the opponent's.Built for the Defenders. Since its preview, we've been working with leading cybersecurity vendors to evaluate Mistral Large 4 in real-world environments to test Mistral Large 4’s strengths in vulnerability reproduction and patching.Mistral Large 4 scores 51% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, which measures a model’s ability to discover vulnerabilities in a codebase, reproduce and validate them, and patch them without breaking existing functionality. Crucially, Mistral Large 4 handles these legitimate defensive security tasks without unnecessary refusals.Artificial Analysis - Cyber Index51%34%36%41%50%56%57%Mistral Large 4Beam 1.0GLM-5.3Kimi K3GLM-5.3 FlashMiMo-V2.6-ProDeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 1017Safety has improved alongside capability. Our model’s built-in guardrails distinguishes between defensive and malicious, offensive cybersecurity tasks. It retains strong performance on Cyber benchmarks, while achieving an average refusal rate of 96.6% on malicious cyber requests, the highest we measure among open models.Refusal of harmful cyber requests95%97%51%84%87%94%Mistral Large 4 PreviewMistral Large 4DeepSeek-V4-ProGemma-4-31BGLM-5.3Kimi K3Average refusal on the cyber-related prompts of JailbreakBench, StrongREJECT and AgentHarmHere’s what global leaders in cybersecurity have to say about Mistral Large 4:In the time since the preview, we carefully monitored cybersecurity-related use in our live traffic. Though we observed the model refusing to comply with black-box attacks against live targets, we see a potential for uplift to conduct real attacks. We are modifying our guardrails accordingly, and will continue updating them in the months to come. We are also providing enterprise design partners such as Orange Cyberdefense, with preview access to a specialized variant of Mistral Large 4 optimized for advanced cybersecurity workflows, including penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and red-teaming. Access is subject to rigorous vetting and contractual safeguards, with testing restricted to owned or explicitly authorized systems in controlled environments.Meanwhile, customers are tailoring Mistral Large 4 with proprietary security data, policies, detection logic, and threat environments using Mistral Forge. For well-defined cybersecurity tasks, it can be further optimized into smaller, task-specific variants for greater accuracy, making security applications more effective.Learn more about sovereign AI for cybersecurity and how to work with us.Built for Work.Mistral Large 4 has continued improving on a range of broad enterprise-use metrics. For finance-related work, we improved the model’s ability to perform real-world workflows, especially ones involving the creation and editing of spreadsheets for finance and accounting use cases. This is reflected in our Finch scores climbing to 73.3%, second only to Kimi K3 for open models. FinWorkBench (Finch)67.4%73.3%65.1%67.4%77.3%Mistral Large 4 - PreviewMistral Large 4GLM-5.3DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813Kimi K3Web browsing is a critical part of a majority of knowledge work. Our RL pipeline enabled us to reach 84.5% on BrowseComp (starting from an SFT checkpoint that was achieving 75%). This brings Mistral Large 4 at a higher performance than models like GLM-5.3 or DeepSeek Flash 4.1 1017.Web browsing - BrowseComp75.084.582.583.491.2Early Mistral Large SFTcheckpointMistral Large 4GLM-5.3DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017Kimi K3Agents deployed by an organization need to be secure. Whether deployed to internal members or external users, agents shouldn’t open you up to threats like system prompt exfiltration or malicious code injection. RL increased our gains on the B3 Agent Security Benchmark, with Mistral Large 4 resisting 97.1% of attacks vs 93.3% in Preview. This places it at the top of the OSS frontier, meaning anyone hosting the model can run a safe agent without additional tuning.B3 Agent security benchmark - Attack resistance93%97%59%83%88%93%Mistral Large 4 PreviewMistral Large 4DeepSeek-V4-ProGemma-4-31BKimi K3GLM-5.3This major investment by Mistral AI reinforces the choice La Banque Postale made over a year ago and underscores the relevance of the long-term strategic partnership we are building together: supporting the emergence of an open and sovereign European AI leader. For a public and citizen bank, technological sovereignty is not optional; it is a key prerequisite for maintaining our customers' trust. The introduction of this open model unlocks new opportunities and use cases. By partnering with Mistral AI, our ambition is to combine the best of human expertise and digital technology to deliver an enhanced experience of both customers and employees over the long term.Zakaria Moursli, Executive Vice President, Operational Performance, Payments and Digital Services, La Banque PostaleSee it in ActionCyber Vulnerability Triage: an agent reads incoming vulnerability reports, investigates the source code and product context, reproduces the flaws in an isolated sandbox, then writes and iterates on a patch until a canary exploit no longer works.Agentic webdev: with no human help, Mistral Large 4 builds Orbital Trace, a live 3D map of roughly 19,000 satellites and debris pieces orbiting Earth. It pulls real tracking data, writes the app, uses it in a browser to catch its own bugs and slowdowns, then fixes what an independent reviewer flags until all requirements pass.Quantum chemistry solver: Mistral Large 4 writes, from scratch, software that calculates where electrons sit in a molecule, and checks its answers against a standard chemistry tool. It then builds a 3D page around it: pick a molecule such as benzene or water, drag a slider to pull it apart, and watch the electrons regroup as the bond breaks.Built for Sovereignty.As organizations build AI around their knowledge and workflows, sovereignty means that they retain control of the models they depend on and the intelligence they create. With Mistral Large 4, that control begins with the model itself. Organizations have the ability to inspect, customize, and deploy the model on their own infrastructure. They can use and improve Mistral Large 4 without depending on Mistral to serve it through an API. Mistral Large 4 was developed and trained from scratch in Europe, giving organizations clarity about the origins of the technology they’re building on. Control also extends to how AI operates inside an organization. Organizations can customize Mistral Large 4 around their proprietary data with Mistral Forge, and they can build, govern, and improve the resulting agents and applications using Mistral Studio. Mistral’s Applied AI experts can work alongside customer teams to build and deploy these tailored systems. Through that work, teams understand the architecture and decisions behind what they’ve built, along with the methods used to train and operate it, so they can run and improve their AI independently. Sovereignty does not always require self-hosting; sometimes it just requires deployments that meet your control requirements. For organizations that prefer a managed service, Mistral Large 4 is available through Microsoft Foundry, with private deployment options for Azure developers.Microsoft and Mistral AI share a commitment to expanding customer choice in next-generation AI. As the first cloud provider to bring Mistral Large 4 to customers, Microsoft is making Mistral’s latest open-weight model available through Microsoft Foundry, an enterprise AI platform built for evaluating, deploying, and operating models at scale. For organizations advancing sovereign AI strategies, this combination offers greater flexibility and control across their data, infrastructure, and AI operations.Tina Schuchman, Corporate Vice President, Foundry, Microsoft Start building with Le ChonkMistral Large 4 is available to try, deploy, and customize today.Get started in Mistral Studio, through the Mistral API, or on OpenRouter. For full control, download the open weights from Hugging Face and deploy on your own infrastructure with vLLM or SGLang. The model card and license have everything you need to get started — and for those who want to go deeper, a full technical report is coming soon.You can also try the new model in Vibe Code; give it a feature to build or a bug to fix in your own repository.Mistral Large 4, is also available through NVIDIA-hosted endpoints, as an optimized NVIDIA NIM container for serving with vLLM. Developers can use the open source NeMo AutoModel library for customization or the open source TensorRT LLM library for high-throughput serving.Enterprises can also tailor Mistral Large 4 to their proprietary data, use cases, and guardrails with Mistral Forge. Talk to our team to learn more.The model is available to use under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license, a modified MIT license. The model is free to use, modify, fine-tune, and commercialize, with a single condition: businesses that operate a Model-as-a-Service offering must obtain a separate commercial license from Mistral before using the model commercially.Starting today, Mistral Large 4 is priced at $0.70 input / M, $0.07 cached input / M, and $2.10 output / M tokens.We encourage the community to put Mistral Large 4 to the test. Run your own evaluations, push its limits, and share your findings with us on X, Discord, or GitHub.What's NextMistral Large 4 will serve as the foundation for a new generation of specialized and optimized Mistral models. Building on recent releases such as Voxtral and Timestral, we'll continue expanding the frontier of open-weight AI, continuing to give developers and enterprises greater freedom to build, customize, and own their intelligence.

comments.author: Topfi
comments.textRawHtml:
They slashed pricing, it's now nearly half vs the preview (Input: $0.7/M Tokens, Output: $2.1/M Tokens vs Input: $1.36/M Tokens, Output: $4.18/M Tokens).

At the original pricing in my evals, Mistral Large 4 Preview was not competitive. With this price point and some improvements on top, this full release warrants a major reassessment.

[0] https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/pricing
comments.textZhHtml:
他们大幅削减了定价，现在价格几乎是预览版的一半（输入：$0.7/M 代币，输出：$2.1/M 代币 vs 输入：$1.36/M 代币，输出：$4.18/M 代币）。

按照我评估的原始定价，Mistral Large 4 预览版没有竞争力。考虑到这个价格点和一些改进，这个完整版本值得进行重大重新评估。

[0] https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/pricing

children.author: almindor
children.textRawHtml:
They didn't. Original price was maybe higher but they slashed it during preview and in fact it was lower by a bit ($0.68/M tokens) and $2.09 for output.

I've been using it for my personal project and it's still too expensive and very slow when thinking. I think we need one more generation from mistral and with maybe 50% of this already "slashed" price for this to be competitive (I use Opus 5.5 at work and it's still much better than this).
children.textZhHtml:
他们没有。原始价格可能更高，但他们在预览期间大幅削减了价格，事实上它降低了一点（0.68 美元/M 代币），输出为 2.09 美元。

我一直在将它用于我的个人项目，但在思考时它仍然太贵且非常慢。我认为我们还需要一代 Mistral，并且价格可能已经“削减”了 50%，这样才能具有竞争力（我在工作中使用 Opus 5.5，它仍然比这好得多）。

children.author: Topfi
children.textRawHtml: I just checked, seems you are right. They had roughly a week with the lower pricing, then increased it, now decrease it again. Very odd. My testing was with the higher pricing and looking at AA, theirs seems to have been too.
children.textZhHtml: 我刚刚查了一下，看来你是对的。他们大约有一周的时间保持较低的价格，然后提高价格，现在又降低价格。很奇怪。我的测试是在更高的定价下进行的，看看 AA，他们的似乎也是如此。

children.author: derefr
children.textRawHtml: Is it odd? I would guess that they're doing cost-plus pricing and the costs have been fluctuating with model revs.
children.textZhHtml: 奇怪吗？我猜他们正在执行成本加成定价，并且成本随着模型转速的变化而波动。

children.author: baq
children.textRawHtml: Token providers in aggregate work a bit like airlines so the end pricing should also work a bit like airlines; expect budget tokens, fast boarding tokens, window seat tokens, last minute tokens, miles for tokens, … and naturally prices fluctuating by the hour.
children.textZhHtml: 代币提供商总体上有点像航空公司，因此最终定价也应该有点像航空公司；预计预算代币、快速登机代币、靠窗座位代币、最后一刻代币、里程代币……自然价格会按小时波动。

children.author: barrell
children.textRawHtml:
Not sure it’s particularly odd. Several models of late have launched with an introductory promotional pricing, only to later lock in the promotional pricing.

Too many models now to remember specifics - I believe deepseek v4 did this and one of the gpt models (5? 5.1? 6?) did this if I recall correctly. I’m also fairly confident Google has had a few promotional periods on launch of the model, I seem to remember them starting the trend.
children.textZhHtml:
不确定这是否特别奇怪。最近有几种型号推出了介绍性促销价格，但后来又锁定了促销价格。

现在型号太多，记不清具体细节了 - 我相信 Deepseek v4 做到了这一点，如果我没记错的话，其中一个 gpt 型号（5？5.1？6？）也做到了这一点。我也相当有信心谷歌在推出该模型时有过一些促销期，我似乎记得他们开创了这一趋势。

children.author: sixhobbits
children.textRawHtml: Yeah I tried mistral 4 when it came out and it honestly felt like going back in time 6 months, suddenly my agents were making all kinds of mistakes that I had kind of forgotten agents regularly used to make

children.author: traceroute66
children.textRawHtml:
> They slashed pricing, it's now nearly half vs the preview (Input: $0.7/M Tokens, Output: $2.1/M Tokens vs Input: $1.36/M Tokens, Output: $4.18/M Tokens).

Those in the EU wanting EU-only inference should be aware Mistral put a 10% tax ("upcharge") on Regional Inference[1].

[1] https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/regional-inference
children.textZhHtml:
> 他们大幅削减了定价，现在价格比预览版低了近一半（输入：$0.7/M 代币，输出：$2.1/M 代币 vs 输入：$1.36/M 代币，输出：$4.18/M 代币）。

欧盟中那些希望仅进行欧盟推理的人应该知道，Mistral 对区域性征收 10% 的税（“附加费”）。推论[1]。

[1] https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/regional-inference

children.author: miroljub
children.textRawHtml:
Why does everyone avoid publishing the most important part of the pricing while doing a comparison?

My coding sessions have a >97% input cache rate. DeepSeek got us spoiled. I am not going to use any AI provider with exorbitant or hidden cache rates.
